prior_mechanical_failures.reason: SSE parser TypeError on null content preamble; no finish reason or [DONE]

reason: The first base-server replay durably captured 213 SSE events but the client parser failed on the OpenAI-compatible initial delta content=null preamble, before finish_reason and [DONE] were recorded. That call is preserved as FAILED and charged. Since the same parser defect could affect every streamed coordinate, all 44 matrix coordinates are re-issued under new IDs after the parser correction; no outcome from the failed stream contributes to scoring.
